update_id_source: the JSON Ledger API v2 submit-and-wait-for-transaction response; unlike the escrowed-DvP reference path (which runs through Daml Script and cannot return ledger update IDs, see UPDATE_ID_FALLBACK), this harness submits directly and records the update ID the ledger returned. The recorded IDs are then cross-checked: the harness independently re-read each update from the participant's own /v2/updates/update-by-id after the fact (settlement-update.json, expire-update.json), and this file rejects the evidence unless the IDs, timestamps, synchronizer, root choices, and transfer amounts in those raw responses agree with what is claimed here
